cases.sentence: «Маша, все это я рассказываю вам как ___.
cases.translation: Masha, I am telling you all this as a writer.
cases.explain: The preposition 'как' (as) requires the dative case when expressing one's role or capacity.

cases.sentence: Любить безнадежно, целые годы все ждать ___.
cases.translation: To love hopelessly, to spend whole years waiting for something.
cases.explain: The verb 'ждать' (to wait for) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: ___ пьет открыто, как я.  А большинство тайно.
cases.translation: The minority drinks openly, like me. And the majority drinks in secret.
cases.explain: The noun Меньшинство serves as the subject of the verb пьет.

cases.translation: He pouts, he snorts, he preaches new forms.
cases.explain: The verb проповедует takes a direct object, so the adjective is in the accusative case.

cases.translation: Yakov walks from left to right with a suitcase.
cases.explain: The preposition 'с' (with) requires the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Well, allow me to wish you all the best.
cases.explain: The fixed phrase 'всего хорошего' uses the genitive case in this idiomatic goodbye expression.

cases.sentence: Я загадала, идти мне в ___ или нет, хоть бы посоветовал кто».
cases.translation: I have decided whether I should go into acting or not, if only someone would advise me.
cases.explain: The noun актрисы is used in the nominative case as a predicate noun after the infinitive идти.

cases.sentence: Я прошу вас принять от меня на память вот этот маленький ___.
cases.translation: I ask you to accept from me as a memento this small medallion.
cases.explain: The noun медальон is the direct object of the verb принять (to accept), so it is in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Перед отъездом дайте мне ___ минуты, умоляю вас».
cases.translation: Before leaving, give me two minutes, I beg you.
cases.explain: The numeral две is in the accusative case as the direct object in the noun phrase две минуты.

cases.sentence: Тебе ли с твоим ___ разъезжать по гостям?»
cases.translation: You with your rheumatism, wandering from house to house?
cases.explain: The preposition 'с' (with) requires the instrumental case.

reading.ru: «Маша, все это я рассказываю вам как писателю.
reading.question: Who is Masha telling Trigorin she is going to marry?
reading.correct: A schoolteacher
reading.explain: Masha says she is marrying Medvedenko, who is a teacher living in the country.

reading.ru: Я вам по совести, если бы он ранил себя серьезно, то я не стала бы жить ни одной минуты.
reading.question: What does Masha mean when she says she would not live another minute?
options: She cannot bear the thought of Trigorin being wounded
She is exaggerating for dramatic effect
She is planning to leave immediately
reading.correct: She is exaggerating for dramatic effect
reading.explain: Masha is expressing her emotional attachment to Trigorin in an exaggerated romantic manner typical of theatrical speech.

reading.ru: Любить безнадежно, целые годы все ждать чего-то.
reading.question: What does Masha say she has done after years of hopeless love?
options: She has decided to wait a little longer
She has decided to marry the teacher
She has given up all hope
reading.correct: She has decided to marry the teacher
reading.explain: Masha explains that after waiting hopelessly for years, she has decided to marry Medvedenko to escape the pain of unrequited love.

reading.ru: А как выйду замуж, будет уже не до любви.
reading.question: What will change after Masha marries?
options: New worries will suppress the old love
She will stop caring about theater
reading.correct: New worries will suppress the old love
reading.explain: Masha believes that new domestic concerns and responsibilities of marriage will distract her from her unrequited feelings for Trigorin.

reading.ru: Меньшинство пьет открыто, как я.  А большинство тайно.
reading.question: What does Masha say about women drinking alcohol?
options: The minority drink openly while the majority drinks secretly
Women should not drink at all
reading.correct: The minority drink openly while the majority drinks secretly
reading.explain: Masha observes that while some women drink openly like she does, most drink in secret, hiding their drinking from society.

reading.ru: «Маша, а вы попросите, чтобы она осталась».
reading.question: What is Trigorin's attitude about leaving the countryside?
options: He does not want to leave at all
He wants to stay but must go for work
reading.correct: He does not want to leave at all
reading.explain: Trigorin explicitly says 'I myself do not want to leave,' expressing his reluctance about departing.

reading.ru: То стрелялся, а теперь, говорят, собирается меня на дуэль вызвать.
reading.question: What does Trigorin say his son is threatening to do?
reading.correct: Challenge him to a duel
reading.explain: Trigorin mentions that his son is said to be planning to challenge him to a duel, which he considers improper behavior.

reading.ru: Дуется, фыркает, проповедует новые формы.
reading.question: How does Trigorin explain his son's behavior?
options: His son is jealous and preaches new forms in literature
His son wants to leave Russia
reading.correct: His son is jealous and preaches new forms in literature
reading.explain: Trigorin attributes the conflict to his son's jealousy and his son's tendency to pout while promoting new literary forms.

reading.ru: Ну-с, позвольте пожелать вам всего хорошего.
reading.question: What reason does Nina give for marrying Medvedenko?
options: To escape the pain of unrequited love and find a new life
reading.correct: To escape the pain of unrequited love and find a new life
reading.explain: Though Nina is not named Masha, the context of hopeless love and escape through marriage mirrors the theme discussed earlier.

reading.ru: Только не пишите многоуважаемой, а просто так.
reading.question: What does Arkadina ask Trigorin about after Masha leaves?
reading.correct: Who just left the room
reading.explain: Arkadina asks Trigorin 'Who just left? Nina?' - she is asking about the identity of the person who departed.

reading.ru: «Нет, у меня на руке только одна горошина.
reading.question: What gift does Nina give to Trigorin?
options: A book of her own poetry
A small medallion with his initials
reading.correct: A small medallion with his initials
reading.explain: Nina gives Trigorin a small medallion with his initials engraved on it and the title of his book 'Days and Nights' on the reverse side.

reading.ru: Я прошу вас принять от меня на память вот этот маленький медальон.
reading.question: What memory does Nina want Trigorin to recall?
options: Their first meeting at the theater
A day last week when she wore a white dress and they saw a seagull
The time they traveled to Moscow together
His promise to help her become an actress
reading.correct: A day last week when she wore a white dress and they saw a seagull
reading.explain: Nina reminds Trigorin of a bright day a week ago when she was wearing a light-colored dress and a white seagull was lying on a bench nearby.

reading.ru: Я буду вспоминать вас, какою вы были в тот ясный день.
reading.question: What does Nina ask Trigorin for before he leaves?
reading.correct: Two minutes alone with him
reading.explain: Nina asks Trigorin to give her two minutes before his departure, as she urgently needs to speak with him.

reading.ru: Перед отъездом дайте мне две минуты, умоляю вас».
reading.question: What does Nina thank Trigorin for?
reading.correct: His kind disposition toward her
reading.explain: Nina expresses gratitude for Trigorin's kindness and good feelings toward her.

reading.ru: Тебе ли с твоим ревматизмом разъезжать по гостям?»
reading.question: What does Arkadina first notice about Konstantin's appearance?
options: He looks like he is wearing a turban or headwrap
reading.correct: He looks like he is wearing a turban or headwrap
reading.explain: Arkadina comments that Konstantin looks as if he is wearing a turban or chalma because of the way his bandage is wrapped around his head.

reading.ru: «Вы уезжаете, без вас мне будет тяжело дома».
reading.question: According to Sarin, what does Konstantin need most?
options: A new play to work on
To dress like a respectable person and some money
reading.correct: To dress like a respectable person and some money
reading.explain: Sarin suggests that Konstantin needs proper clothing and some money, noting that he has worn the same shabby coat for three years.

reading.ru: Хочется хоть на час-другой воспрянуть от этой пискариной жизни.
reading.question: What does Sarin say about providing money to Konstantin?
options: He has plenty of money to give
He has no money because his manager takes his entire pension
Arkadina should give all her money to him
The government should support young writers
reading.correct: He has no money because his manager takes his entire pension
reading.explain: Sarin explains that his manager takes his entire pension and spends it on agriculture and livestock, leaving him with nothing.

reading.ru: Наблюдай за сыном, береги его, наставляй.
reading.question: What is Arkadina's primary concern about giving Konstantin money?
options: She does not believe he deserves it
She has no money because she spends it all on costumes
She thinks he would waste it on theater
She is too old to work anymore
reading.correct: She has no money because she spends it all on costumes
reading.explain: Arkadina explains that as an actress, she uses all her money on expensive clothing and costumes, so she cannot help Konstantin financially.

reading.ru: Никаких занятий, стыдится и боится своей праздности.
reading.question: What sign does Arkadina show of concern for her son?
options: She changes his bandage and reminds him of past acts of kindness
She refuses to speak with him
reading.correct: She changes his bandage and reminds him of past acts of kindness
reading.explain: Arkadina is caring and tender with Konstantin, changing his bandage for him and reminiscing about times when she was kind to those in need.

reading.ru: «Мне кажется, было бы самое лучшее, если бы ты дала ему немного денег.
reading.question: What does Konstantin say about his suicide attempt?
options: It was a moment of madness he regrets and says will not repeat
He does not remember what happened
reading.correct: It was a moment of madness he regrets and says will not repeat
reading.explain: Konstantin assures his mother that his attempted suicide was a moment of desperation and madness that will never happen again.

reading.ru: Нет, в настоящее время и на костюм не могу.
reading.question: What does Konstantin's memory reveal about his feelings for his mother?
options: He resents her for working as an actress
He loves her tenderly and completely as in childhood
He prefers his uncle to her
He thinks she is cold and uncaring
reading.correct: He loves her tenderly and completely as in childhood
reading.explain: Konstantin tells his mother that lately he loves her with the same tender devotion he had as a child, and that she is now his only remaining attachment.

reading.ru: «Будь у меня деньги, понятная вещь, я бы сам дал ему, но у меня ничего нет, ни пятачка!»
reading.question: Why does Arkadina defend Trigorin?
options: She is in love with him
She believes he is a noble and talented person
She is afraid of his influence
She wants to prove herself right
reading.correct: She is in love with him
reading.explain: Arkadina passionately defends Trigorin because she is emotionally attached to him and sees him as admirable.

reading.ru: Я тебя уважаю, да, но опять со мною что-то того».
reading.question: What accusation does Konstantin make about Trigorin's courage?
options: Trigorin is a coward who ran away when challenged
Trigorin is too old to fight
reading.correct: Trigorin is a coward who ran away when challenged
reading.explain: Konstantin accuses Trigorin of shameful flight when he learned that Konstantin was going to challenge him to a duel.

reading.ru: Ходит Треплев с повязкой на голове Медведенко.
reading.question: What is Arkadina's response to Trigorin reading the inscription on the medallion?
options: She is angry he is reading it
She asks if everything is packed for departure
reading.correct: She asks if everything is packed for departure
reading.explain: While Trigorin is absorbed in reading the inscription on Nina's medallion, Arkadina matter-of-factly asks if his packing is complete.

reading.ru: Утром на четырех, в полдень на двух, вечером на трех».
reading.question: What does Trigorin repeatedly recall from the medallion?
options: The quote 'If you ever need my life, come and take it'
reading.correct: The quote 'If you ever need my life, come and take it'
reading.explain: Trigorin is deeply moved by the quote on the medallion and repeats it to himself several times, contemplating its meaning.

reading.ru: Вот если бы ты, мама, вдруг расщедрилась и дала ему взаймы тысячи полторы-две, то он мог бы прожить в городе целый год».
reading.question: Why does Trigorin become emotionally conflicted?
options: He is torn between his obligation to Arkadina and his attraction to Nina
He is afraid of traveling by train
reading.correct: He is torn between his obligation to Arkadina and his attraction to Nina
reading.explain: Trigorin is pulled between his relationship with Arkadina and his feelings for Nina, unable to resist the allure of young love.

highlight.question: Which sentence describes the setting of Act Three?
highlight.explain: The stage direction identifies this as the dining room in Sorin's house, which is the location for the entire act.

highlight.question: Which sentence shows Trigorin responding to Nina's coin-flip question?
sentences: Я загадала, идти мне в актрисы или нет, хоть бы посоветовал кто».
highlight.explain: Trigorin responds to Nina's question 'Heads or tails?' with his answer 'Heads,' recorded in the stage direction.

highlight.question: Which sentence shows Arkadina's opinion about going abroad?
sentences: Да и погулять малому не мешало бы.
Все-таки, пожалуй, на костюм я еще могу, но чтоб за границу...
highlight.explain: Arkadina's response makes clear she cannot afford to send Konstantin abroad or even to buy him new clothes at present.

highlight.question: Which sentence indicates Arkadina is changing Konstantin's bandage?
sentences: Вчера один приезжий спрашивал на кухне какой ты национальности, а у тебя почти совсем зажило.
«А ты без меня опять не сделаешь чик-чик?»
highlight.explain: The stage direction 'She removes the bandage from his head' shows the action of tending to his wound.

highlight.question: Which sentence expresses Konstantin's emotional despair?
highlight.explain: These sentences together capture Konstantin's loss of everything: his beloved does not love him and he can no longer write.

highlight.question: Which sentence shows Trigorin declaring his true feelings despite his relationship with Arkadina?
sentences: Теперь вот она, эта любовь пришла, наконец.
Какой же смысл бежать от нее?
highlight.explain: Trigorin's question about the meaning of fleeing from such a love reveals his internal struggle and desire to pursue Nina.

highlight.question: Which sentence shows Shamrayev making a humorous observation?
sentences: Раз в одной мелодраме они играли заговорщиков, и когда их вдруг накрыли, то надо было сказать «мы попали в западню», а Измайлов «мы попали в запандю».
Пока он говорит, Яков хлопочет около чемодана, горничная приносит Аркадиной шляпу, манто, зонтик, перчатки.
highlight.explain: Shamrayev's laugh and the exclamation 'For the pan!' make a comic point about the actor Izmailov's mispronunciation of 'trap' (zapandyu instead of zapanyu).

highlight.question: Which sentences express Trigorin's poetic admiration for Nina?
sentences: О, какое счастье думать, что мы скоро увидимся.
Она склоняется к нему на грудь.
Я опять увижу эти чудные глаза, невыразимо прекрасную нежную улыбку, эти кроткие черты, выражение ангельской чистоты.
highlight.explain: These lines reveal Trigorin's romanticized vision of Nina as he reflects on how wonderful it will be to see her again soon in Moscow.
